Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 4: Prologue
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 4: Prologue is a lite version of the later released game Gran Turismo 4. In reality, this game, although a full game in its own right, is really nothing more than a extended demo of what to expect in the final release of Gran Turismo 4.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 4: Prologue
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 4 Prologue est une simulation automobile proposant de nombreux circuits et véhicules de toutes marques. Le jeu permet en outre d'apprendre la conduite comme un pro grâce à une série de leçons appliquées.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 4: Prologue
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 4 Prologue ist eine Autosimulation mit zahlreichen Strecken und Fahrzeugen aller Marken. Das Spiel ermöglicht es Ihnen auch, das Fahren wie ein Profi durch eine Reihe praktischer Lektionen zu erlernen.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 4: Prologue
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 4 Prologue es una simulación automotriz que ofrece muchos circuitos y vehículos de todas las marcas. El juego también le permite aprender conducir como un profesional a través de una serie de lecciones aplicadas.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 4: Prologue
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 4: Prologue è una versione lite dell'ultimo gioco rilasciato Gran Turismo 4. In realtà, questo gioco, sebbene sia un gioco completo a sé stante, non è altro che una demo estesa di cosa aspettarsi nella versione finale di Gran Turismo 4.

Localization.Description: GT4 continues in its predecessors' footsteps by offering an extremely large list of cars; the PAL version features 721 cars from 80 manufacturers. Players now accumulate points by winning races in the normal first-person driving mode, called A-Spec mode.

Localization.Description: Desde los escarpados Alpes franceses hasta las áridas planicies de desierto africano, World Rally Championship te ofrece todo un abanico de posibilidades: más de 100 tramos de pistas, reconstruidos con los datos obtenidos vía satélite de 14 de los encuen

Localization.Title: WRC: World Rally Championship (Demo)
Localization.Description: World Rally Championship is a rally driving game for the PlayStation 2. It is the first rallying game to be officially licensed by the FIA World Rally Championship and is based on the 2001 WRC season.

Localization.Description: While Jak is a handsome young hero with big blue eyes and bushy blond hair, his companion Daxter has been transformed into a small weasel-like creature by a strange dark curse.

Localization.Title: Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy (Demo)
Localization.Description: Jak and Daxter est un jeu de plates-formes/aventure sur Playstation 2. Vous incarnez Jak et devez aider votre ami Daxter à retrouver sa forme "humaine". En effet, après être tombé dans de l'éco noire, Daxter a été transformé en adorable beloutre.

Localization.Title: Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy (Demo)
Localization.Description: Ein spannendes Abenteuer. Eine unerforschte, atemberaubende Welt. Ein bester Freund, der sich in ein Pelzknäuel verwandelt. Du bist dabei, dich auf eine sehr ungewönliche Reise zu begeben.

Localization.Title: Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy (Demo)
Localization.Description: Jak es un hombre con una misión. Daxter no es un hombre, pero también tiene una misión. El objetivo es encontrar una cura para conseguir que Daxter deje de ser una bola de pelo con tres dedos en cada pata y vuelva a su glorioso ser.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy X (Demo)
Localization.Description: Square's acclaimed role-playing series makes its PlayStation 2 debut with Final Fantasy X. Players assume the role of Tidus, an athletic teenager who witnessed the destruction of his home city by an evil entity named Sin.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy X (Demo)
Localization.Description: Final Fantasy X est un jeu de rôle sorti sur Playstation 2. Le monde de Spira vit dans la crainte d'une entité maléfique nommée Sin.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy X (Demo)
Localization.Description: Die Spiele der Final Fantasy-Serie haben bisher allesamt tolle Hintergrundgeschichten, Charaktere, strategische Kämpfe, spaßige Mini-Spiele und stundenlangen Spielspaß geboten - auch Final Fantasy X bildet da keine Ausnahme.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy X (Demo)
Localization.Description: "Listen to my story, this may be our last chance" ("Escucha mi historia, ésta podría ser nuestra última oportunidad") -Tidus, al comienzo de juego. Tidus es un joven, estrella del Blitzball, que juega en los Zanarkand Abes (el equipo de su ciudad).

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy X (Demo)
Localization.Description: L'acclamata serie di giochi di ruolo di Square fa il suo debutto su PlayStation 2 con Final Fantasy X.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy X (Demo)
Localization.Description: A história de Final Fantasy X se passa no mundo fantástico de Spira e segue um grupo de aventureiros e sua busca para derrotar um monstro conhecido como Sin.

Localization.Title: Dropship: United Peace Force (Demo)
Localization.Description: Dropship is an action game set in the year 2050. Terrorist attacks have increased severely, which is why big nations of the world decided to form the UPF, "United Peace Force", replacing the UN and NATO. It is an anti-terror army, operating world-wide.

Localization.Title: Dropship: United Peace Force (Demo)
Localization.Description: Dropship est un jeu d'action sorti sur Playstation 2. La paix et la prospérité mondiale sont menacées et c'est à vous et votre appareil d'endiguer cela. C'est au cours de 30 missions explosives, chacune précédée d'un tutoriel, que vous sauverez le monde.

Localization.Title: Dropship: United Peace Force (Demo)
Localization.Description: Dropship ist ein Actionspiel für Playstation 2. Weltfrieden und Wohlstand sind in Gefahr und es liegt an Ihnen und Ihrem Gerät, dies zu stoppen. In 30 explosiven Missionen, denen jeweils ein Tutorial vorangeht, werden Sie die Welt retten.

Localization.Title: Dropship: United Peace Force (Demo)
Localization.Description: Dropship es un juego de acción ambientado en el año 2050. Los ataques terroristas han aumentado considerablemente, razón por la cual grandes naciones del mundo decidieron formar la UPF, "United Peace Force", en sustitución de la ONU y la OTAN.

Localization.Title: Dropship: United Peace Force (Demo)
Localization.Description: Dropship è un gioco d'azione ambientato nell'anno 2050. Gli attacchi terroristici sono aumentati notevolmente, motivo per cui le grandi nazioni del mondo hanno deciso di formare l'UPF, "United Peace Force", in sostituzione dell'ONU e della NATO.

Localization.Title: Dropship: United Peace Force (Demo)
Localization.Description: Dropship é um jogo de ação ambientado no ano de 2050. Os ataques terroristas aumentaram severamente, razão pela qual grandes nações do mundo decidiram formar a UPF, "United Peace Force", substituindo a ONU e a OTAN.

Localization.Description: Ratchet & Clank involves the two protagonists Ratchet, a furry alien creature, and Clank, a nerdy little robot, going on a quest to find Captain Qwark and ultimately to help save the galaxy.

Localization.Description: Ratchet & Clank met en scène Ratchet, une créature extraterrestre à poils, et Clank, un petit robot ringard, qui partent à la recherche du capitaine Qwark pour sauver la galaxie.

Localization.Title: Frequency (Demo)
Localization.Description: A rhythm and music game -- played using audio triggers instead of visual triggers. The goal is to piece together each track of a song within a certain time period; not piecing enough tracks together loses the round.

Localization.Title: Frequency (Demo)
Localization.Description: FreQuency est un jeu de rythme sorti sur PlayStation 2. Préparez-vous à vraiment ressentir les vibrations de vos chansons grâce à ce jeu qui base ses tracés en fonction de la musique. Vous pourrez affronter jusqu'à 3 amis grâce au multitap.

Localization.Title: Frequency (Demo)
Localization.Description: FreQuency ist ein Rhythmus-Spiel, das für PlayStation 2 veröffentlicht wurde. Machen Sie sich bereit, die Stimmung Ihrer Songs mit diesem Spiel, dessen Handlung auf der Musik basiert, wirklich zu spüren.

Localization.Description: Frequency es un juego musical en el que puedes crear tus propias composiciones a la vez que sigues el ritmo de la música.

Localization.Description: Gran Turismo Concept 2002 Tokyo-Geneva est un jeu de courses sorti sur Playstation 2. Parcourez de célèbres pistes de courses de Tokyo à Genève à bord de plus de 100 véhicules différents, des voitures de rallye aux voitures de courses classiques.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo Concept: Nissan Z (Demo)
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo Concept 2002 Tokyo-Geneva ist ein Rennspiel für Playstation 2. Fahren Sie in über 100 verschiedenen Fahrzeugen, vom Rallyeauto bis zum klassischen Rennwagen, über berühmte Rennstrecken von Tokio bis Genf.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo Concept: Nissan Z (Demo)
Localization.Description: En Gran Turismo Concept 2002 Tokyo-Geneva puedes hacer realidad tus sueños y conducir coches que nunca hubieras imaginado.

Localization.Description: Tekken 4 picks up two years after Tekken 3. Heihachi and his scientists have captured samples of Ogre's blood and tissue to splice with Heihachi's genome and make him immortal. The experiment fails, since Heihachi lacks the necessary Devil Gene.

Localization.Description: Tekken 4 est un jeu de combat sur Playstation 2 qui propose 23 personnages possèdant tous un style de combat différent du jeet kune do au karaté en passant par le muay thai.

Localization.Description: Tekken 4 ist ein Kampfspiel für Playstation 2, das 23 Charaktere mit jeweils unterschiedlichen Kampfstilen bietet, von Jeet Kune Do bis hin zu Karate und Muay Thai.

Localization.Title: Ghosthunter (Demo)
Localization.Description: Ghosthunter ist ein Action-/Abenteuerspiel für Playstation 2. Werden Sie Agent Lazarus Jones und kämpfen Sie gegen böse Mächte, die auf jede erdenkliche Weise eliminiert werden müssen.

Localization.Title: Ghosthunter (Demo)
Localization.Description: Eres Lazarus, un policía de Detroit que investiga una relación de crímenes inexplicables en una universidad abandonada.

Localization.Title: Ghosthunter (Demo)
Localization.Description: Players take the role of Lazarus Jones, a rookie cop, in this action-oriented horror adventure by Sony's Cambridge studios.

Localization.Title: Dog's Life (Demo)
Localization.Description: In Dog's Life you play Jake the puppy, as he explores the USA in an attempt to foil a fiendish plot. Miss Peaches doesn't like dogs, and sees them as a way of making money, by dog-napping Daisy the pedigree dog.

Localization.Title: Dog's Life (Demo)
Localization.Description: Dog's Life redonne un sens à l'expression "quelle vie de chien". Dans la peau d'un bon gros toutou vous aurez à vivre votre vie de tous les jours dans votre quartier, en rendant des services aux autres ou en récoltant des odeurs.

Localization.Title: Dog's Life (Demo)
Localization.Description: Dog's Life gibt dem Ausdruck „Was für ein Hundeleben“ eine neue Bedeutung. In der Rolle eines guten, großen Hundes müssen Sie Ihren Alltag in Ihrer Nachbarschaft leben, indem Sie anderen Dienste leisten oder Gerüche sammeln.

Localization.Title: Dog's Life (Demo)

Localization.Title: Destruction Derby Arenas (Demo)
Localization.Description: The PS1 Destruction Derby titles would put you in the seat of a high powered vehicle, in either an arena or a track, and the target was to race to the finish, while causing as much destruction to the other cars as possible. Now comes the PS2 sequel.

Localization.Title: Destruction Derby Arenas (Demo)
Localization.Description: Destruction Derby : Arenas sur PS2 est un jeu de courses un peu particulier. Ici, le but est de pulvériser les voitures de vos adversaires. Pour cela, vous disposez d'un arsenal divers et varié équipant votre véhicule.

Localization.Title: Destruction Derby Arenas (Demo)
Localization.Description: Destruction Derby: Arenas auf PS2 ist ein ganz besonderes Rennspiel. Hier besteht das Ziel darin, die Autos Ihrer Gegner zu pulverisieren. Dafür steht Ihnen ein vielfältiges und abwechslungsreiches Arsenal zur Ausstattung Ihres Fahrzeugs zur Verfügung.

Localization.Title: Destruction Derby Arenas (Demo)
Localization.Description: Con sus tres explosivos títulos para PS1, Destruction Derby te atrapó con sus potentes coches de carreras y animó a salir a todo gas a estrellarte con todo.

Localization.Title: Destruction Derby Arenas (Demo)
Localization.Description: I titoli PS1 Destruction Derby ti metterebbero al posto di un veicolo ad alta potenza, in un'arena o in una pista, e l'obiettivo era quello di correre fino al traguardo, causando la maggior distruzione possibile alle altre auto.

Localization.Title: Forbidden Siren (Demo)
Localization.Description: The story of Forbidden Siren (European title), released as Siren in Japan in 2003, centers on a land-locked village in Japan that disappears following the loud blaring of a siren.

Localization.Title: Forbidden Siren (Demo)
Localization.Description: Forbidden Siren est un survival-horror sur PS2. Attirés par le son de la sirène, les habitants du village d'Hanuda s'engouffrent dans la mer couleur rouge sang, et en ressortent sous la forme de morts-vivants.

Localization.Title: Forbidden Siren (Demo)
Localization.Description: Forbidden Siren ist ein Survival-Horrorspiel für PS2. Angezogen vom Klang der Sirene stürzen sich die Bewohner des Dorfes Hanuda in das blutrote Meer und tauchen in Gestalt lebender Toten wieder auf.

Localization.Title: Forbidden Siren (Demo)
Localization.Description: Prepárate para quedar atrapado en la pesadilla que ha envuelto a Hanyuda, un pueblo japonés que se encuentra ahora anegado por fuerzas maléficas, y rodeado por un mar de sangre.

Localization.Title: Forbidden Siren (Demo)
Localization.Description: È mezzanotte. L'urlo di una sirena squarcia il cielo notturno. Un mare rosso sangue sommerge la terra che circonda il villaggio di Hanuda.

Localization.Title: Forbidden Siren (Demo)
Localization.Description: Forbidden Siren é um survival-horror para a PS2. Atraídos pelo som da sirene, os habitantes da aldeia de Hanuda mergulham no mar vermelho-sangue e emergem como mortos-vivos.

Localization.Title: I-Ninja (Demo)
Localization.Description: A robot army led by Master O-Dor has destroyed the ninja clan. As the last of your kind you must take on the robot army and defeat Master O-Dor. I Ninja is a 3D platform title starring an original character created by British developer Argonaut Software.

Localization.Title: I-Ninja (Demo)
Localization.Description: Une armée de robots dirigée par Maître O-Dor a détruit le clan des ninjas. En tant que dernier représentant de ton espèce, tu dois affronter l'armée de robots et vaincre Maître O-Dor.

Localization.Title: I-Ninja (Demo)
Localization.Description: I-Ninja für PS2 ist ein Action-Plattformspiel, in dem Sie als Attentäter schlüpfen, der ein Experte im Umgang mit Schwertern ist und dessen legendäre Wut zu seinem bösen Charakter passt.

Localization.Title: I-Ninja (Demo)
Localization.Description: El más puro sabor de la esencia oriental viene de la mano de un ninja pequeño y cabezón: I-Ninja, un juego de acción trepidante y plataformas con el que pasar muy buenos ratos.

Localization.Title: I-Ninja (Demo)
Localization.Description: Un esercito di robot guidato dal Maestro O-Dor ha distrutto il clan ninja. Essendo l'ultimo della tua specie, dovrai affrontare l'esercito di robot e sconfiggere il Maestro O-Dor.

Localization.Title: I-Ninja (Demo)
Localization.Description: A robot army led by Master O-Dor has destroyed the ninja clan. As the last of your kind you must take on the robot army and defeat Master O-Dor. I Ninja is a 3D platform title starring an original character created by British developer Argonaut Software.

Localization.Description: Gran Turismo Concept is a racing video game of the Gran Turismo series for PlayStation 2 which is developed by Polyphony Digital. It is essentially a short version of Gran Turismo 3: A-Spec, but with concept cars that ended up in Gran Turismo 4.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo Special Edition 2004 Geneva Version (Demo)
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo Concept 2002 Tokyo-Geneva est un jeu de courses sorti sur Playstation 2. Parcourez de célèbres pistes de courses de Tokyo à Genève à bord de plus de 100 véhicules différents, des voitures de rallye aux voitures de courses classiques.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo Special Edition 2004 Geneva Version (Demo)
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo Concept 2002 Tokyo-Geneva ist ein Rennspiel für Playstation 2. Fahren Sie in über 100 verschiedenen Fahrzeugen, vom Rallyeauto bis zum klassischen Rennwagen, über berühmte Rennstrecken von Tokio bis Genf.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo Special Edition 2004 Geneva Version (Demo)
Localization.Description: En Gran Turismo Concept 2002 Tokyo-Geneva puedes hacer realidad tus sueños y conducir coches que nunca hubieras imaginado.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo Special Edition 2004 Geneva Version (Demo)
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo Concept è un videogioco di corse della serie Gran Turismo per PlayStation 2 sviluppato da Polyphony Digital. È essenzialmente una versione breve di Gran Turismo 3: A-Spec, ma con concept car finite in Gran Turismo 4.

Localization.Description: SingStar is a competitive music video game series for PlayStation consoles, developed by London Studio and published by Sony Computer Entertainment. Dozens of installments were released for the PlayStation 2, and several more for the PlayStation 3.

Localization.Description: Singstar est un vrai karaoke disponible sur Playstation 2. Pour jouer, c'est très simple. Que ce soit seul ou entre amis, il suffit de choisir son morceau, d'attraper le micro, et de chanter ! Plus de 30 titres et clips originaux sont présents.

Localization.Description: Singstar ist ein echtes Karaoke, das auf der Playstation 2 verfügbar ist. Es ist sehr einfach zu spielen. Ob alleine oder mit Freunden, einfach Lied auswählen, Mikrofon schnappen und singen! Es sind mehr als 30 Originaltitel und -clips vorhanden.

Localization.Description: AirBlade takes place in the near future as a man named Oscar has developed a perpetual energy source that will revolutionize the world, however, the GCP Corporation has discovered it as well and fears that it will hurt the company which is heavily invest

Localization.Title: AirBlade
Localization.Description: Airblade sur Playstation 2 est un jeu de sport futuriste dans lequel vous utilisez un overboard, sorte de skate anti-gravité inspiré de Retour vers le Futur.

Localization.Title: AirBlade
Localization.Description: Airblade auf Playstation 2 ist ein futuristisches Sportspiel, in dem Sie ein Overboard verwenden, eine Art Anti-Schwerkraft-Skateboard, inspiriert von „Zurück in die Zukunft“.

Localization.Title: AirBlade
Localization.Description: AirBlade tiene lugar en un futuro cercano cuando un hombre llamado Oscar ha desarrollado una fuente de energía perpetua que revolucionará el mundo, sin embargo, GCP Corporation también lo ha descubierto y teme que perjudique a la empresa que está fuertem

Localization.Title: AirBlade

Localization.Title: AirBlade
Localization.Description: AirBlade se passa em um futuro próximo, quando um homem chamado Oscar desenvolveu uma fonte de energia perpétua que revolucionará o mundo, no entanto, a GCP Corporation também a descobriu e teme que isso prejudique a empresa que investe pesadamente em em

Localization.Title: ATV Offroad: All Terrain Vehicle
Localization.Description: Get ready for adrenaline in ATV Offroad - All Terrain Vehicle, a racing game on rough terrain! Choose from several ATV models, each with their own unique characteristics, and master challenging tracks in different environments.

Localization.Title: ATV Offroad: All Terrain Vehicle
Localization.Description: ATV Off Road sur Playstation 2 permet à l'utilisateur de découvrir l'univers du quad. Environ une vingtaine de courses et d'environnements variés en indoor et outdoor vous familiariseront avec l'engin.

Localization.Title: ATV Offroad: All Terrain Vehicle
Localization.Description: ATV Off Road auf der Playstation 2 ermöglicht es dem Benutzer, die Welt des Quadfahrens zu entdecken. Rund zwanzig Rennen und abwechslungsreiche Indoor- und Outdoor-Umgebungen machen Sie mit der Maschine vertraut.

Localization.Title: ATV Offroad: All Terrain Vehicle
Localization.Description: La poderosa secuela de uno de los primeros títulos de carreras de PS2, ATV Offroad presenta más de 20 vehículos todo terreno auténticos y 40 entornos de carreras. Los modos de carrera incluyen carreras Nacionales, Supercross, Freestyle Stunt y Enduro.

Localization.Title: ATV Offroad: All Terrain Vehicle
Localization.Description: Get ready for adrenaline in ATV Offroad - All Terrain Vehicle, a racing game on rough terrain! Choose from several ATV models, each with their own unique characteristics, and master challenging tracks in different environments.

Localization.Title: ATV Offroad: All Terrain Vehicle
Localization.Description: Prepare-se para a adrenalina em ATV Offroad - All Terrain Vehicle, um jogo de corrida em terrenos acidentados! Escolha entre diversos modelos de quadriciclos, cada um com suas características únicas, e domine pistas desafiadoras em diferentes ambientes.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 3: A-Spec
Localization.Description: The third game in the Gran Turismo series of racing games for PlayStation and PlayStation 2. This time with an even more realistic driving experience. Lighting now has an effect on the game, such as buildings blocking the sunlight.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 3: A-Spec
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 3 sur Playstation 2 est le troisième opus de la série Gran Turismo. Le titre propose un mode arcade pour se lancer dans des courses rapides, dans des contre-la-montre ainsi qu'un mode libre pour rouler sans contraintes.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 3: A-Spec
Localization.Description: Autofahrer im Paradies: Morgens das Garagentor aufziehen und von Wagen wie Dodge Viper, Lotus Elise, Jaguar XJ 220, Aston Martin DB7 oder einer Corvette angelächelt werden, die ihre glänzend polierten Motorhauben in der Sonne blitzen lassen die Tür öffne

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 3: A-Spec
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 3 fue el primero de la serie para la Playstation 2, se mejoraron notoriamente los gráficos y el sistema de juego. Una nueva característica fueron los cambios de aceite.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 3: A-Spec
Localization.Description: Il terzo gioco della serie di giochi di corse Gran Turismo per PlayStation e PlayStation 2. Questa volta con un'esperienza di guida ancora più realistica. L'illuminazione ora ha un effetto sul gioco, come edifici che bloccano la luce solare.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 3: A-Spec
Localization.Description: The third game in the Gran Turismo series of racing games for PlayStation and PlayStation 2. This time with an even more realistic driving experience. Lighting now has an effect on the game, such as buildings blocking the sunlight.

Localization.Title: Dark Cloud
Localization.Description: Dark Cloud is set within a fantastic world with two moons called Terra. The world is made of two main continents referred to as the East and West.

Localization.Title: Dark Cloud
Localization.Description: Dark Cloud sur Playstation 2 est un jeu de rôle mêlant action et aventure. Un méchant général dénommé Flagg décide de ravager votre village. Sous les traits d'un jeune garçon, Toan, vous assistez au désastre.

Localization.Title: Dark Cloud
Localization.Description: Dark Cloud spielt in einer Fantasie Welt mit zwei Monden namens Terra. Die Welt besteht aus zwei Hauptkontinenten, die als Osten und Westen bezeichnet werden.

Localization.Title: Dark Cloud
Localization.Description: Dark Cloud se desarrolla en un mundo fantástico con dos lunas, llamado Terra. El mundo está formado por dos continentes principales, llamados el Este y el Oeste.

Localization.Title: Dark Cloud
Localization.Description: Dark Cloud is set within a fantastic world with two moons called Terra. The world is made of two main continents referred to as the East and West.

Localization.Title: Dark Cloud
Localization.Description: Em Dark Cloud, embarque em uma jornada épica para salvar o mundo em perigo.

Localization.Title: Time Crisis II
Localization.Description: Play alone or team up with a friend in this traditional light gun shooter. Christy Ryan, the agent responsible for uncovering the corporation's hidden agenda, attempts to escape NDI captivity and report the details of the plot to V.S.S.E.

Localization.Title: Time Crisis II
Localization.Description: Time Crisis II est un jeu de tir sur PS2. Votre mission est de venir en aide à une collègue appartenant aux services secrets qui à été kidnappée par des trafiquants d'armes.

Localization.Title: Time Crisis II
Localization.Description: Time Crisis II ist ein Shooter für PS2. Ihre Mission ist es, einem Geheimdienstkollegen zu Hilfe zu kommen, der von Waffenhändlern entführt wurde. Bereiten Sie sich auf eine Reihe gnadenloser Schlachten in diesem verrückten Wettlauf gegen die Zeit vor.

Localization.Title: Time Crisis II
Localization.Description: Time Crisis II es un rail shooter arcade. Tu misión es ayudar a un compañero de los servicios secretos que ha sido secuestrado por traficantes de armas. Prepárate para una serie de batallas despiadadas en esta loca carrera contra el tiempo.

Localization.Title: Time Crisis II
Localization.Description: Time Crisis II è uno sparatutto per PS2. La vostra missione è aiutare un collega dei servizi segreti che è stato rapito da trafficanti d'armi. Preparatevi a una serie di spietate battaglie in questa folle prova a tempo.

Localization.Title: Time Crisis II
Localization.Description: Time Crisis II é um jogo de tiros para a PS2. A tua missão é ajudar um colega dos serviços secretos que foi raptado por traficantes de armas. Prepara-te para uma série de batalhas impiedosas neste louco contrarrelógio.

Localization.Title: Klonoa 2: Lunatea's Veil
Localization.Description: Fans of the original Klonoa for the PS can set forth in a new adventure on a new system with this release of Klonoa 2: Lunatea's Veil.

Localization.Title: Klonoa 2: Lunatea's Veil
Localization.Description: Klonoa 2 : Lunatea's Veil est un jeu de plates-formes sur Playstation 2. Préparez-vous à vivre des sensations uniques dans l'univers fantastique de Lunatea.

Localization.Title: Klonoa 2: Lunatea's Veil
Localization.Description: Klonoa 2: Lunatea's Veil ist ein Plattformspiel für Playstation 2. Bereiten Sie sich darauf vor, einzigartige Sensationen im fantastischen Universum von Lunatea zu erleben.

Localization.Title: Klonoa 2: Lunatea's Veil
Localization.Description: Los fanáticos del Klonoa original para PS pueden emprender una nueva aventura en un nuevo sistema con este lanzamiento de Klonoa 2: El Mundo de Lunatea.

Localization.Title: Klonoa 2: Lunatea's Veil
Localization.Description: Fans of the original Klonoa for the PS can set forth in a new adventure on a new system with this release of Klonoa 2: Lunatea's Veil.

Localization.Title: Klonoa 2: Lunatea's Veil
Localization.Description: Fans of the original Klonoa for the PS can set forth in a new adventure on a new system with this release of Klonoa 2: Lunatea's Veil.

Localization.Title: Twisted Metal: Black
Localization.Description: Twisted Metal: Black is a demolition derby that permits the usage of ballistic projectiles. Players choose a vehicle and an arena?or a series of arenas in the story mode?to engage in battle with opposing drivers.

Localization.Title: Twisted Metal: Black
Localization.Description: Twisted Metal : Black est un jeu d'action sur Playstation 2. Dans un univers résolument macabre, le joueur choisit une voiture et doit se battre dans des arènes contre d'autres véhicules tout aussi armés.

Localization.Title: Twisted Metal: Black
Localization.Description: Twisted Metal: Black ist ein Actionspiel für Playstation 2. In einem ausgesprochen makabren Universum wählt der Spieler ein Auto und muss in Arenen gegen andere ebenso bewaffnete Fahrzeuge kämpfen.

Localization.Title: Twisted Metal: Black
Localization.Description: En lo profundo de la mente, en el corazón del alma, se halla la locura en todos nosotros. El descenso a lo oscuro revela la locura, donde un silencio turbador está a punto de dar paso a la anarquía total. Sólo hay una salida... Twisted Metal: Black™.

Localization.Title: Twisted Metal: Black
Localization.Description: Twisted Metal: Black is a demolition derby that permits the usage of ballistic projectiles. Players choose a vehicle and an arena?or a series of arenas in the story mode?to engage in battle with opposing drivers.

Localization.Title: Twisted Metal: Black
Localization.Description: Twisted Metal: Black is a demolition derby that permits the usage of ballistic projectiles. Players choose a vehicle and an arena?or a series of arenas in the story mode?to engage in battle with opposing drivers.

Localization.Title: Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy
Localization.Description: While Jak is a handsome young hero with big blue eyes and bushy blond hair, his companion Daxter has been transformed into a small weasel-like creature by a strange dark curse.

Localization.Title: Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy
Localization.Description: Jak and Daxter est un jeu de plates-formes/aventure sur Playstation 2. Vous incarnez Jak et devez aider votre ami Daxter à retrouver sa forme "humaine". En effet, après être tombé dans de l'éco noire, Daxter a été transformé en adorable beloutre.

Localization.Title: Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy
Localization.Description: Ein spannendes Abenteuer. Eine unerforschte, atemberaubende Welt. Ein bester Freund, der sich in ein Pelzknäuel verwandelt. Du bist dabei, dich auf eine sehr ungewönliche Reise zu begeben.

Localization.Title: Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy
Localization.Description: Jak es un hombre con una misión. Daxter no es un hombre, pero también tiene una misión. El objetivo es encontrar una cura para conseguir que Daxter deje de ser una bola de pelo con tres dedos en cada pata y vuelva a su glorioso ser.

Localization.Title: Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy
Localization.Description: While Jak is a handsome young hero with big blue eyes and bushy blond hair, his companion Daxter has been transformed into a small weasel-like creature by a strange dark curse.

Localization.Title: Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy
Localization.Description: While Jak is a handsome young hero with big blue eyes and bushy blond hair, his companion Daxter has been transformed into a small weasel-like creature by a strange dark curse.

Localization.Title: PaRappa the Rapper 2
Localization.Description: Parappa the Rapper 2, the direct sequel to Sony Computer Entertainment's 1997 smash-hit, picks up where the original left off with our hero now firmly entrenched in a relationship with his girlfriend Sunny.

Localization.Title: PaRappa the Rapper 2
Localization.Description: Parappa the Rapper 2 est un jeu de rythme sur Playstation 2. Une invasion de nouilles s'abat sur la ville. Parappa décide de prendre les choses en main et de découvrir qui se cache derrière cette mascarade. Le tout grâce au pouvoir du rap.

Localization.Title: PaRappa the Rapper 2
Localization.Description: Parappa the Rapper 2 ist ein Rhythmus-Spiel für Playstation 2. Eine Nouilles-Invasion landet in der Stadt. Parappa beschließt, die Hauptauswahl zu treffen und herauszufinden, dass sie diese Mascara dort aufbewahren möchte. Alles Gute für den Rap.

Localization.Title: PaRappa the Rapper 2
Localization.Description: Parappa the Rapper 2, la secuela directa del gran éxito de Sony Computer Entertainment en 1997, comienza donde lo dejó el original con nuestro héroe ahora firmemente arraigado en una relación con su novia Sunny.

Localization.Title: PaRappa the Rapper 2
Localization.Description: Parappa the Rapper 2, the direct sequel to Sony Computer Entertainment's 1997 smash-hit, picks up where the original left off with our hero now firmly entrenched in a relationship with his girlfriend Sunny.

Localization.Title: PaRappa the Rapper 2
Localization.Description: Parappa the Rapper 2, the direct sequel to Sony Computer Entertainment's 1997 smash-hit, picks up where the original left off with our hero now firmly entrenched in a relationship with his girlfriend Sunny.

Localization.Title: MotoGP 2
Localization.Description: Namco, the genius company behind Tekken and Ridge Racer, has also proved itself a dab-hand at the motorcycle racing game. Early 2001, the arcade giant released Moto GP for PlayStation 2, and its runaway success quickly led to the research of a sequel.

Localization.Title: MotoGP 2
Localization.Description: MotoGP 2 est un jeu de courses de motos sorti sur Playstation 2. Retrouvez les véritables pilotes grâce à la licence officielle et courez sur 10 pistes existantes.

Localization.Title: MotoGP 2
Localization.Description: MotoGP 2 ist ein Motorrad-Rennspiel für Playstation 2. Finden Sie dank der offiziellen Lizenz die echten Fahrer und fahren Sie auf 10 vorhandenen Strecken Rennen.

Localization.Title: MotoGP 2
Localization.Description: Basado en el Campeonato del Mundo de la FIM, MotoGP 2 refleja perfectamente la esencia de la serie de Namco conduciendo a los jugadores a lo largo del mundo por de los circuitos más arduos enfrentándolos a los conductores más intrépidos.

Localization.Title: MotoGP 2
Localization.Description: Namco, the genius company behind Tekken and Ridge Racer, has also proved itself a dab-hand at the motorcycle racing game. Early 2001, the arcade giant released Moto GP for PlayStation 2, and its runaway success quickly led to the research of a sequel.

Localization.Title: MotoGP 2
Localization.Description: Namco, the genius company behind Tekken and Ridge Racer, has also proved itself a dab-hand at the motorcycle racing game. Early 2001, the arcade giant released Moto GP for PlayStation 2, and its runaway success quickly led to the research of a sequel.

Localization.Title: Ace Combat: Distant Thunder
Localization.Description: Ace Combat makes its first trip on the Playstation 2.

Localization.Title: Ace Combat: Distant Thunder
Localization.Description: Ace Combat : Distant Thunder est une simulation de combats aériens contemporaine sortie sur Playstation 2. Pilotez les avions de chasse les plus puissants qui existent dans un conflit dévastateur et partez en guerre avec vos amis en multijoueur.

Localization.Title: Ace Combat: Distant Thunder
Localization.Description: Ace Combat: Distant Thunder ist eine moderne Luftkampfsimulation für Playstation 2. Steuere die stärksten Kampfjets, die es gibt, in einem verheerenden Konflikt und ziehe im Mehrspielermodus mit deinen Freunden in den Krieg.

Localization.Title: Ace Combat: Distant Thunder
Localization.Description: Ace Combat: Distant Thunder, es el cuarto videojuego de la serie Ace Combat y el primer videojuego de la serie desarrollado para PlayStation 2. La historia tiene lugar después de los eventos de Ace Combat 2 en el continente de Usea.

Localization.Title: Ace Combat: Distant Thunder
Localization.Description: Ace Combat makes its first trip on the Playstation 2.

Localization.Title: Ace Combat: Distant Thunder
Localization.Description: Ace Combat: Distant Thunder, lançado em 2001 para PlayStation 2, é um simulador de voo de combate aéreo frenético que coloca você no papel de um piloto de elite em um mundo devastado por uma guerra entre duas superpotências.

Localization.Title: Vampire Night
Localization.Description: Vampire Night is a light gun game produced by Sega's Wow Entertainment, distributed through Namco and released in 2000 for video game arcades. It was later ported to PlayStation 2 in November 2001. Two players can team up to take down on screen enemies.

Localization.Title: Vampire Night
Localization.Description: Vampire Night sur Playstation 2 est un jeu de tir qui se déroule dans un univers gothique. Vous vous retrouvez dans la peau d'un chasseur de vampires avec qui vous parcourez 6 niveaux et quelques zones secrètes.

Localization.Title: Vampire Night
Localization.Description: Vampire Night auf Playstation 2 ist ein Shooter, der in einem Gothic-Universum spielt. Du schlüpfst in die Rolle eines Vampirjägers, mit dem du 6 Level und einige geheime Bereiche durchläufst.

Localization.Title: Vampire Night
Localization.Description: A través de los tiempos, una oscura fuerza ha permanecido dormida, esperando el momento para romper la paz y la prosperidad de la humanidad. Por cada hora de luz solar, vendrá una hora mucho más negra, y por cada siglo de armonía, un período de terror.

Localization.Title: Vampire Night
Localization.Description: Vampire Night is a light gun game produced by Sega's Wow Entertainment, distributed through Namco and released in 2000 for video game arcades. It was later ported to PlayStation 2 in November 2001. Two players can team up to take down on screen enemies.

Localization.Title: Vampire Night
Localization.Description: Adentre um mundo de trevas e mistério em Vampire Night para PlayStation 2! Este emocionante jogo de tiro em primeira pessoa coloca você no papel de um caçador de vampiros, encarregado de eliminar as criaturas da noite que assombram a cidade.

Localization.Title: Dropship: United Peace Force
Localization.Description: Dropship is an action game set in the year 2050. Terrorist attacks have increased severely, which is why big nations of the world decided to form the UPF, "United Peace Force", replacing the UN and NATO. It is an anti-terror army, operating world-wide.

Localization.Title: Dropship: United Peace Force
Localization.Description: Dropship est un jeu d'action sorti sur Playstation 2. La paix et la prospérité mondiale sont menacées et c'est à vous et votre appareil d'endiguer cela. C'est au cours de 30 missions explosives, chacune précédée d'un tutoriel, que vous sauverez le monde.

Localization.Title: Dropship: United Peace Force
Localization.Description: Dropship ist ein Actionspiel für Playstation 2. Weltfrieden und Wohlstand sind in Gefahr und es liegt an Ihnen und Ihrem Gerät, dies zu stoppen. In 30 explosiven Missionen, denen jeweils ein Tutorial vorangeht, werden Sie die Welt retten.

Localization.Title: Dropship: United Peace Force
Localization.Description: Dropship es un juego de acción ambientado en el año 2050. Los ataques terroristas han aumentado considerablemente, razón por la cual grandes naciones del mundo decidieron formar la UPF, "United Peace Force", en sustitución de la ONU y la OTAN.

Localization.Title: Dropship: United Peace Force
Localization.Description: Dropship è un gioco d'azione ambientato nell'anno 2050. Gli attacchi terroristici sono aumentati notevolmente, motivo per cui le grandi nazioni del mondo hanno deciso di formare l'UPF, "United Peace Force", in sostituzione dell'ONU e della NATO.

Localization.Title: Dropship: United Peace Force
Localization.Description: Dropship é um jogo de ação ambientado no ano de 2050. Os ataques terroristas aumentaram severamente, razão pela qual grandes nações do mundo decidiram formar a UPF, "United Peace Force", substituindo a ONU e a OTAN.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy X
Localization.Description: Square's acclaimed role-playing series makes its PlayStation 2 debut with Final Fantasy X. Players assume the role of Tidus, an athletic teenager who witnessed the destruction of his home city by an evil entity named Sin.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy X
Localization.Description: Final Fantasy X est un jeu de rôle sorti sur Playstation 2. Le monde de Spira vit dans la crainte d'une entité maléfique nommée Sin.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy X
Localization.Description: Die Spiele der Final Fantasy-Serie haben bisher allesamt tolle Hintergrundgeschichten, Charaktere, strategische Kämpfe, spaßige Mini-Spiele und stundenlangen Spielspaß geboten - auch Final Fantasy X bildet da keine Ausnahme.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy X
Localization.Description: "Listen to my story, this may be our last chance" ("Escucha mi historia, ésta podría ser nuestra última oportunidad") -Tidus, al comienzo de juego. Tidus es un joven, estrella del Blitzball, que juega en los Zanarkand Abes (el equipo de su ciudad).

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy X
Localization.Description: L'acclamata serie di giochi di ruolo di Square fa il suo debutto su PlayStation 2 con Final Fantasy X.

Localization.Title: Final Fantasy X
Localization.Description: A história de Final Fantasy X se passa no mundo fantástico de Spira e segue um grupo de aventureiros e sua busca para derrotar um monstro conhecido como Sin.

Localization.Title: Ecco the Dolphin: Defender of the Future
Localization.Description: Hundreds of years in the future, mankind and dolphins live peacefully together and share the earth. Dolphins, who are much more intelligent than they seem, act as the earth's caretakers, while dolphins and humans explore the galaxy.

Localization.Description: En Ecco the Dolphin: Defender of the Future, controlas a Ecco, que es enviado al pasado para intentar restaurar el paraíso de su futuro.

Localization.Description: Enter a dark future where bounty hunters rule the streets and human organs are the preferred currency. Take the role of Jack Wade, a man whose memory has been stolen.

Localization.Title: Headhunter
Localization.Description: Headhunter für Playstation 2 ist ein Actionspiel, in dem Sie als Jack Wade spielen, ein ehemaliger Polizist, der zum Kopfgeldjäger wurde. Eine junge Frau beauftragt Sie, die Mörder ihres Vaters zu finden.

Localization.Description: Peter Pan?s archenemy, Captain Hook, is on a futile quest for revenge and he?s stolen Neverland?s fairies. Without pixie dust, the forever-young cheeky chappie has lost his ability to fly.

Localization.Title: Space Channel 5
Localization.Description: Oben, unten, rechts, links und Tchu sind die fünf Schlüsselwörter von Space Channel 5 auf Playstation 2. Sie müssen den Choreografien folgen, die Ihnen die schöne Fernsehmoderatorin namens Ulalla zeigt.

Localization.Title: Virtua Fighter 4
Localization.Description: Virtua Fighter 4 est un jeu de combat sur Playstation 2. Vous pouvez choisir de combattre avec 13 personnages qui ont chacun leur style différent : du kung-fu au jeet kun do en passant par le jujitsu et le catch.

Localization.Title: Virtua Fighter 4
Localization.Description: Virtua Fighter 4 ist ein Kampfspiel für Playstation 2. Sie können wählen, ob Sie mit 13 Charakteren kämpfen möchten, von denen jeder seinen eigenen Stil hat: von Kung Fu über Jeet Kun Do bis hin zu Ju-Jitsu und Wrestling.

Localization.Title: Virtua Fighter 4
Localization.Description: Bienvenidos al 4º Torneo Mundial de Lucha, donde el que ataca triunfa y el que se defiende sólo sobrevive. Escoge entre 13 luchadores y reta a tus rivales en combates de artes marciales avanzadas.

Localization.Title: Ico
Localization.Description: A young boy in a magical world has been born with a strange deformity: large horns that jut out of both sides of his head.

Localization.Title: Ico
Localization.Description: Ico est un jeu d'action/aventure sorti sur Playstation 2. Incarnez Ico, un jeune garçon injustement enfermé par ses pairs parce qu'il porte des cornes sur la tête. Ico doit s'échapper de sa prison.

Localization.Title: Ico
Localization.Description: Ico ist ein Action-/Abenteuerspiel für Playstation 2. Spielen Sie als Ico, ein kleiner Junge, der von seinen Mitschülern zu Unrecht eingesperrt wurde, weil er Hörner auf dem Kopf trägt. Ico muss aus seinem Gefängnis fliehen.

Localization.Title: Ico
Localization.Description: Un niño en un mundo mágico ha nacido con una extraña deformidad: grandes cuernos que sobresalen de ambos lados de su cabeza.

Localization.Title: Ico
Localization.Description: A young boy in a magical world has been born with a strange deformity: large horns that jut out of both sides of his head.

Localization.Title: Ico
Localization.Description: Um jovem garoto em um mundo mágico nasceu com uma estranha deformidade: grandes chifres que se projetam de ambos os lados de sua cabeça.

Localization.Title: Destruction Derby Arenas
Localization.Description: The PS1 Destruction Derby titles would put you in the seat of a high powered vehicle, in either an arena or a track, and the target was to race to the finish, while causing as much destruction to the other cars as possible. Now comes the PS2 sequel.

Localization.Title: Destruction Derby Arenas
Localization.Description: Destruction Derby : Arenas sur PS2 est un jeu de courses un peu particulier. Ici, le but est de pulvériser les voitures de vos adversaires. Pour cela, vous disposez d'un arsenal divers et varié équipant votre véhicule.

Localization.Title: Destruction Derby Arenas
Localization.Description: Destruction Derby: Arenas auf PS2 ist ein ganz besonderes Rennspiel. Hier besteht das Ziel darin, die Autos Ihrer Gegner zu pulverisieren. Dafür steht Ihnen ein vielfältiges und abwechslungsreiches Arsenal zur Ausstattung Ihres Fahrzeugs zur Verfügung.

Localization.Title: Destruction Derby Arenas
Localization.Description: Con sus tres explosivos títulos para PS1, Destruction Derby te atrapó con sus potentes coches de carreras y animó a salir a todo gas a estrellarte con todo.

Localization.Title: Destruction Derby Arenas
Localization.Description: I titoli PS1 Destruction Derby ti metterebbero al posto di un veicolo ad alta potenza, in un'arena o in una pista, e l'obiettivo era quello di correre fino al traguardo, causando la maggior distruzione possibile alle altre auto.

Localization.Title: Destruction Derby Arenas
Localization.Description: The PS1 Destruction Derby titles would put you in the seat of a high powered vehicle, in either an arena or a track, and the target was to race to the finish, while causing as much destruction to the other cars as possible. Now comes the PS2 sequel.

Localization.Title: Frequency
Localization.Description: A rhythm and music game -- played using audio triggers instead of visual triggers. The goal is to piece together each track of a song within a certain time period; not piecing enough tracks together loses the round.

Localization.Title: Frequency
Localization.Description: FreQuency est un jeu de rythme sorti sur PlayStation 2. Préparez-vous à vraiment ressentir les vibrations de vos chansons grâce à ce jeu qui base ses tracés en fonction de la musique. Vous pourrez affronter jusqu'à 3 amis grâce au multitap.

Localization.Title: Frequency
Localization.Description: FreQuency ist ein Rhythmus-Spiel, das für PlayStation 2 veröffentlicht wurde. Machen Sie sich bereit, die Stimmung Ihrer Songs mit diesem Spiel, dessen Handlung auf der Musik basiert, wirklich zu spüren.

Localization.Title: Frequency
Localization.Description: Frequency es un juego musical en el que puedes crear tus propias composiciones a la vez que sigues el ritmo de la música.

Localization.Title: Frequency
Localization.Description: A rhythm and music game -- played using audio triggers instead of visual triggers. The goal is to piece together each track of a song within a certain time period; not piecing enough tracks together loses the round.

Localization.Title: Frequency
Localization.Description: Frequency é um jogo musical no qual você pode criar suas próprias composições seguindo o ritmo da música. Usando músicas dos principais artistas, você pode mixar e remixar músicas em cada um dos oito tipos de instrumentos diferentes.

Localization.Title: Smash Court Tennis: Pro Tournament
Localization.Description: In this officially licensed tennis game from Namco, you can play in all four major tournaments of the tennis season: The Australian Open, Wimbeldon, the French Open and the US Open, with the best players in the world including Andre Agassi, Lleyton Hewit

Localization.Title: Smash Court Tennis: Pro Tournament

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo Concept: 2002 Tokyo-Geneva
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo Concept is a racing video game of the Gran Turismo series for PlayStation 2 which is developed by Polyphony Digital. It is essentially a short version of Gran Turismo 3: A-Spec, but with concept cars that ended up in Gran Turismo 4.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo Concept: 2002 Tokyo-Geneva
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo Concept 2002 Tokyo-Geneva est un jeu de courses sorti sur Playstation 2. Parcourez de célèbres pistes de courses de Tokyo à Genève à bord de plus de 100 véhicules différents, des voitures de rallye aux voitures de courses classiques.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo Concept: 2002 Tokyo-Geneva
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo Concept 2002 Tokyo-Geneva ist ein Rennspiel für Playstation 2. Fahren Sie in über 100 verschiedenen Fahrzeugen, vom Rallyeauto bis zum klassischen Rennwagen, über berühmte Rennstrecken von Tokio bis Genf.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo Concept: 2002 Tokyo-Geneva
Localization.Description: En Gran Turismo Concept 2002 Tokyo-Geneva puedes hacer realidad tus sueños y conducir coches que nunca hubieras imaginado.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo Concept: 2002 Tokyo-Geneva
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo Concept è un videogioco di corse della serie Gran Turismo per PlayStation 2 sviluppato da Polyphony Digital. È essenzialmente una versione breve di Gran Turismo 3: A-Spec, ma con concept car finite in Gran Turismo 4.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo Concept: 2002 Tokyo-Geneva

Localization.Title: Tekken 4
Localization.Description: Tekken 4 picks up two years after Tekken 3. Heihachi and his scientists have captured samples of Ogre's blood and tissue to splice with Heihachi's genome and make him immortal. The experiment fails, since Heihachi lacks the necessary Devil Gene.

Localization.Title: Tekken 4
Localization.Description: Tekken 4 est un jeu de combat sur Playstation 2 qui propose 23 personnages possèdant tous un style de combat différent du jeet kune do au karaté en passant par le muay thai.

Localization.Title: Tekken 4
Localization.Description: Tekken 4 ist ein Kampfspiel für Playstation 2, das 23 Charaktere mit jeweils unterschiedlichen Kampfstilen bietet, von Jeet Kune Do bis hin zu Karate und Muay Thai.

Localization.Title: Tekken 4
Localization.Description: Tekken 4 es la cuarta entrega de la franquicia de juegos Tekken, y fue el segundo de la serie de Tekken para PlayStation 2.

Localization.Title: Tekken 4
Localization.Description: Tekken 4 picks up two years after Tekken 3. Heihachi and his scientists have captured samples of Ogre's blood and tissue to splice with Heihachi's genome and make him immortal. The experiment fails, since Heihachi lacks the necessary Devil Gene.

Localization.Title: Tekken 4
Localization.Description: Em Tekken 4 para PS2, assuma o papel de Heihachi Mishima em sua jornada implacável por vingança contra seu filho, Kazuya.

Localization.Title: Ape Escape 2
Localization.Description: Ape Escape 2 is the sequel to Ape Escape. In this platform game it's your goal to catch all the apes jumping, walking and flying around the diverse levels the game has to offer.

Localization.Title: Ape Escape 2
Localization.Description: Ape Escape 2 est un jeu de plates-formes sur PS2 baignant dans une atmosphère totalement délirante. Les primates mégalos sont de retour et se sont échappés dans la nature. Vous devez les retrouver rapidement avant que la situation ne dégénère davantage.

Localization.Title: Ape Escape 2
Localization.Description: Ape Escape 2 ist ein Plattformspiel für PS2 mit einer völlig verrückten Atmosphäre. Die größenwahnsinnigen Primaten sind zurück und in die Wildnis entkommen. Sie müssen sie schnell finden, bevor die Situation weiter eskaliert.

Localization.Title: Ape Escape 2
Localization.Description: Ape Escape 2 es la secuela de Ape Escape. En este juego de plataformas tu objetivo es atrapar a todos los simios saltando, caminando y volando por los diversos niveles que ofrece el juego.

Localization.Title: Ape Escape 2

Localization.Title: Ape Escape 2

Localization.Title: Alpine Racer 3

Localization.Title: Pac-Man World 2
Localization.Description: This sequel to Pac-Man World has the circular yellow star running and jumping through a 3D world instead of the side-scrolling stages found in the original.

Localization.Title: Pac-Man World 2
Localization.Description: Pac-Man se lance dans une toute nouvelle aventure et doit une fois de plus affronter la bande des fantômes. Dans Pac-Man World 2, la bande des fantômes a cueilli le fruit magique d'un arbre ancien, libérant ainsi des forces maléfiques sur Pac-Land.

Localization.Title: Pac-Man World 2
Localization.Description: Vor langer Zeit, im Mittelalter, hatte ein böser Geist namens Spooky das gesamte Pac-Land terrorisiert. Als Reaktion darauf kreierte der große Zauberer Pac einen Trank, der aus 5 gewöhnlichen Früchten die "Goldene Frucht" machte.

Localization.Title: Pac-Man World 2
Localization.Description: Hacía mucho tiempo, un espíritu malvado llamado Spooky sembraba y esparcía terror en Pac-Land, y únicamente pudo ser derrotado cuando el joven jinete Sir Pac-Alot lo encerró en un árbol del centro cuando anexó las cinco Frutas de oro.

Localization.Title: Ratchet & Clank
Localization.Description: Ratchet & Clank involves the two protagonists Ratchet, a furry alien creature, and Clank, a nerdy little robot, going on a quest to find Captain Qwark and ultimately to help save the galaxy.

Localization.Title: Ratchet & Clank
Localization.Description: Ratchet & Clank met en scène Ratchet, une créature extraterrestre à poils, et Clank, un petit robot ringard, qui partent à la recherche du capitaine Qwark pour sauver la galaxie.

Localization.Title: Ratchet & Clank
Localization.Description: In Ratchet & Clank begeben sich die beiden Protagonisten Ratchet, ein pelziges außerirdisches Wesen, und Clank, ein nerdiger kleiner Roboter, auf die Suche nach Captain Qwark, um letztlich die Galaxie zu retten.

Localization.Title: Ratchet & Clank
Localization.Description: Ratchet & Clank presenta a Ratchet, una peluda criatura alienígena, y a Clank, un pequeño robot empollón, que van en busca del Capitán Qwark para salvar la galaxia.

Localization.Title: Ratchet & Clank
Localization.Description: Ratchet & Clank ha come protagonisti Ratchet, una creatura aliena pelosa, e Clank, un piccolo robot nerd, che vanno alla ricerca del Capitano Qwark per salvare la galassia.

Localization.Title: Ratchet & Clank
Localization.Description: Ratchet & Clank apresenta Ratchet, uma criatura extraterrestre peluda, e Clank, um pequeno robot nerd, que vai em busca do Capitão Qwark para salvar a galáxia.

Localization.Title: Sly Raccoon
Localization.Description: Sly Cooper is the latest in a long line of master thieves. When he was a kit, a gang called the Fiendish Five killed his family and divided up their book on the art of thieving: the Thievius Raccoonus.

Localization.Title: Sly Raccoon
Localization.Description: Sly Raccoon est un jeu de plates-formes 3D sur Playstation 2. Le Volus Ratonus, la Bible du cambriolage, a été volé à la famille de Sly alors que ce dernier n'était encore qu'un jeune raton laveur.

Localization.Title: Sly Raccoon
Localization.Description: Sly Raccoon ist ein 3D-Plattformspiel für Playstation 2. Der Volus Ratonus, die Bibel des Einbruchs, wurde Slys Familie gestohlen, als er noch ein junger Waschbär war.

Localization.Title: Sly Raccoon

Localization.Title: Ape Escape 2
Localization.Description: Ape Escape 2 is the sequel to Ape Escape. In this platform game it's your goal to catch all the apes jumping, walking and flying around the diverse levels the game has to offer.

Localization.Title: Ape Escape 2
Localization.Description: Ape Escape 2 est un jeu de plates-formes sur PS2 baignant dans une atmosphère totalement délirante. Les primates mégalos sont de retour et se sont échappés dans la nature. Vous devez les retrouver rapidement avant que la situation ne dégénère davantage.

Localization.Title: Ape Escape 2
Localization.Description: Ape Escape 2 ist ein Plattformspiel für PS2 mit einer völlig verrückten Atmosphäre. Die größenwahnsinnigen Primaten sind zurück und in die Wildnis entkommen. Sie müssen sie schnell finden, bevor die Situation weiter eskaliert.

Localization.Title: Ape Escape 2
Localization.Description: Ape Escape 2 es la secuela de Ape Escape. En este juego de plataformas tu objetivo es atrapar a todos los simios saltando, caminando y volando por los diversos niveles que ofrece el juego.

Localization.Title: Ape Escape 2
Localization.Description: Ape Escape 2 is the sequel to Ape Escape. In this platform game it's your goal to catch all the apes jumping, walking and flying around the diverse levels the game has to offer.

Localization.Title: Ape Escape 2
Localization.Description: Ape Escape 2: Capture macacos malvados e salve o mundo! Em Ape Escape 2, o jovem Hikaru embarca em uma missão hilária para impedir que um exército de macacos domine o mundo! Use um arsenal de gadgets malucos, explore mundos vibrantes e enfrente desafios

Localization.Title: Primal
Localization.Description: Jen is the girlfriend of a metal rocker named Lewis, who have both been through rough times in the past together. A strange and powerful creature attacks Lewis after a concert and runs off into the night with him, leaving Jen injured and near-death.

Localization.Title: Primal
Localization.Description: Primal est un jeu d'action/aventure sorti sur Playstation 2. Incarnez la jeune Jen catapultée dans un royaume de démons où se déroule un affrontement brutal entre des forces élémentaires.

Localization.Title: Primal
Localization.Description: Primal ist ein Action-/Abenteuerspiel für Playstation 2. Spielen Sie als junge Jen, die in ein Reich der Dämonen katapultiert wird, wo ein brutaler Zusammenstoß zwischen Elementarkräften stattfindet.

Localization.Title: Primal
Localization.Description: Primal es un juego de acción/aventura lanzado en Playstation 2. Encarna a la joven Jen catapultada a un reino de demonios donde tiene lugar un choque brutal entre fuerzas elementales.

Localization.Title: The Getaway
Localization.Description: Mark Hammond is an ex-gangster who wants to forget his past and live honestly with his wife and little son.

Localization.Title: The Getaway
Localization.Description: The Getaway est un jeu d'action sur Playstation 2 dans lequel vous incarnez successivement deux personnages. John Hammond vient de sortir de prison lorsqu'il assiste à l'assassinat de sa femme et à l'enlèvement de son fils.

Localization.Title: The Getaway
Localization.Description: The Getaway ist ein Actionspiel für Playstation 2, in dem Sie nacheinander zwei Charaktere spielen. John Hammond wurde gerade aus dem Gefängnis entlassen, als er Zeuge der Ermordung seiner Frau und der Entführung seines Sohnes wird.

Localization.Title: The Getaway
Localization.Description: The Getaway es un juego de acción para Playstation 2 en el que juegas sucesivamente con dos personajes. John Hammond acaba de salir de la cárcel cuando presencia el asesinato de su esposa y el secuestro de su hijo.

Localization.Description: Mark Hammond é um ex-gangster que deseja esquecer seu passado e viver honestamente com sua esposa e seu filho pequeno.

Localization.Title: The Mark of Kri
Localization.Description: In this action adventure, you play Rau, a warrior hero. Accompanying him is his sacred bird, Kuzo, who helps him by activating items, scouting ahead, and reading ancient scripts. This is a beat 'em up game with many twists.

Localization.Title: The Mark of Kri
Localization.Description: The Mark of Kri est un beat'em all sur Playstation 2.

Localization.Title: The Mark of Kri
Localization.Description: Ambientado en un antiguo mundo maorí repleto de espadas y hechiceros, The Mark of Kri sobrevive a los poderes oscuros y consigue invocar seis partes de un tenebroso embrujo que desencadenará un antiguo mal por todo el territorio.

Localization.Title: Dark Chronicle
Localization.Description: Mit der Ausnahme eines kleinen Dorfes wurde die ganze Welt von einem Fiesling namens Griffon zerstört. In diesem von der Außenwelt abgeschotteten Dörfchen lebt Maximilian, der Gehilfe eines Erfinders (und selbst auch ein recht helles Köpfchen).

Localization.Title: Dark Chronicle
Localization.Description: Como joven inventor, se te pide que busques en las peligrosas mazmorras, luches contra monstruos malvados y recuperes pueblos y ciudades. Al abrirte paso por las distintas mazmorras, debes encontrar varios minerales escondidos.

Localization.Description: The story of Forbidden Siren (European title), released as Siren in Japan in 2003, centers on a land-locked village in Japan that disappears following the loud blaring of a siren.

Localization.Title: Forbidden Siren
Localization.Description: Forbidden Siren est un survival-horror sur PS2. Attirés par le son de la sirène, les habitants du village d'Hanuda s'engouffrent dans la mer couleur rouge sang, et en ressortent sous la forme de morts-vivants.

Localization.Title: Forbidden Siren
Localization.Description: È mezzanotte. L'urlo di una sirena squarcia il cielo notturno. Un mare rosso sangue sommerge la terra che circonda il villaggio di Hanuda.

Localization.Title: Forbidden Siren
Localization.Description: Forbidden Siren é um survival-horror para a PS2. Atraídos pelo som da sirene, os habitantes da aldeia de Hanuda mergulham no mar vermelho-sangue e emergem como mortos-vivos.

Localization.Description: Destruction Derby : Arenas sur PS2 est un jeu de courses un peu particulier. Ici, le but est de pulvériser les voitures de vos adversaires. Pour cela, vous disposez d'un arsenal divers et varié équipant votre véhicule.

Localization.Title: Destruction Derby Arenas
Localization.Description: Destruction Derby: Arenas auf PS2 ist ein ganz besonderes Rennspiel. Hier besteht das Ziel darin, die Autos Ihrer Gegner zu pulverisieren. Dafür steht Ihnen ein vielfältiges und abwechslungsreiches Arsenal zur Ausstattung Ihres Fahrzeugs zur Verfügung.

Localization.Title: Destruction Derby Arenas
Localization.Description: Con sus tres explosivos títulos para PS1, Destruction Derby te atrapó con sus potentes coches de carreras y animó a salir a todo gas a estrellarte con todo.

Localization.Description: I titoli PS1 Destruction Derby ti metterebbero al posto di un veicolo ad alta potenza, in un'arena o in una pista, e l'obiettivo era quello di correre fino al traguardo, causando la maggior distruzione possibile alle altre auto.

Localization.Title: SingStar
Localization.Description: SingStar is a competitive music video game series for PlayStation consoles, developed by London Studio and published by Sony Computer Entertainment. Dozens of installments were released for the PlayStation 2, and several more for the PlayStation 3.

Localization.Description: Singstar est un vrai karaoke disponible sur Playstation 2. Pour jouer, c'est très simple. Que ce soit seul ou entre amis, il suffit de choisir son morceau, d'attraper le micro, et de chanter ! Plus de 30 titres et clips originaux sont présents.

Localization.Title: Forbidden Siren
Localization.Description: The story of Forbidden Siren (European title), released as Siren in Japan in 2003, centers on a land-locked village in Japan that disappears following the loud blaring of a siren.

Localization.Title: Forbidden Siren
Localization.Description: Forbidden Siren est un survival-horror sur PS2. Attirés par le son de la sirène, les habitants du village d'Hanuda s'engouffrent dans la mer couleur rouge sang, et en ressortent sous la forme de morts-vivants.

Localization.Title: Forbidden Siren
Localization.Description: Forbidden Siren ist ein Survival-Horrorspiel für PS2. Angezogen vom Klang der Sirene stürzen sich die Bewohner des Dorfes Hanuda in das blutrote Meer und tauchen in Gestalt lebender Toten wieder auf.

Localization.Title: Forbidden Siren
Localization.Description: Prepárate para quedar atrapado en la pesadilla que ha envuelto a Hanyuda, un pueblo japonés que se encuentra ahora anegado por fuerzas maléficas, y rodeado por un mar de sangre.

Localization.Title: Forbidden Siren
Localization.Description: È mezzanotte. L'urlo di una sirena squarcia il cielo notturno. Un mare rosso sangue sommerge la terra che circonda il villaggio di Hanuda.

Localization.Title: Forbidden Siren
Localization.Description: Forbidden Siren é um survival-horror para a PS2. Atraídos pelo som da sirene, os habitantes da aldeia de Hanuda mergulham no mar vermelho-sangue e emergem como mortos-vivos.

Localization.Title: This Is Football 2005
Localization.Description: This is the 2005, and last, edition of the This is Football game series. It allows you to take an existing team and take control of them and guide them through a season by season basis.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 4: Prologue
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 4: Prologue is a lite version of the later released game Gran Turismo 4. In reality, this game, although a full game in its own right, is really nothing more than a extended demo of what to expect in the final release of Gran Turismo 4.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 4: Prologue
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 4 Prologue est une simulation automobile proposant de nombreux circuits et véhicules de toutes marques. Le jeu permet en outre d'apprendre la conduite comme un pro grâce à une série de leçons appliquées.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 4: Prologue
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 4 Prologue ist eine Autosimulation mit zahlreichen Strecken und Fahrzeugen aller Marken. Das Spiel ermöglicht es Ihnen auch, das Fahren wie ein Profi durch eine Reihe praktischer Lektionen zu erlernen.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 4: Prologue
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 4 Prologue es una simulación automotriz que ofrece muchos circuitos y vehículos de todas las marcas. El juego también le permite aprender conducir como un profesional a través de una serie de lecciones aplicadas.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 4: Prologue
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 4: Prologue è una versione lite dell'ultimo gioco rilasciato Gran Turismo 4. In realtà, questo gioco, sebbene sia un gioco completo a sé stante, non è altro che una demo estesa di cosa aspettarsi nella versione finale di Gran Turismo 4.

Localization.Title: Gran Turismo 4: Prologue
Localization.Description: Gran Turismo 4: Prologue is a lite version of the later released game Gran Turismo 4. In reality, this game, although a full game in its own right, is really nothing more than a extended demo of what to expect in the final release of Gran Turismo 4.

Localization.Title: Ratchet & Clank 3
Localization.Description: In Ratchet & Clank: Up Your Arsenal, Ratchet and Clank once again team up for an all-new adventure that combines diverse gameplay with elements of action, exploration, adventure, puzzle-solving, strategy, and role-playing into one experience.

Localization.Title: Ratchet & Clank 3
Localization.Description: Rejoignez Ratchet et Clank dans leurs troisièmes aventures sur PS2 pour défaire les plans machiavéliques du Dr Nefarious. En plus des nombreux gadgets, plus de 15 armes différentes sont à votre disposition pour défourailler autour de vous.

Localization.Title: Ratchet & Clank 3
Localization.Description: Begleiten Sie Ratchet und Clank bei ihrem dritten Abenteuer auf PS2, um die bösen Pläne von Dr. Nefarious zu vereiteln.

Localization.Title: Ratchet & Clank 3
Localization.Description: Únete a Ratchet y a Clank en su odisea a través de la galaxia para salvar a todos los organismos amantes de la libertad del malvado Dr. Nefarius.

Localization.Title: Ratchet & Clank 3
Localization.Description: In Ratchet & Clank: Up Your Arsenal, Ratchet and Clank once again team up for an all-new adventure that combines diverse gameplay with elements of action, exploration, adventure, puzzle-solving, strategy, and role-playing into one experience.

Localization.Title: Ratchet & Clank 3
Localization.Description: In Ratchet & Clank: Up Your Arsenal, Ratchet and Clank once again team up for an all-new adventure that combines diverse gameplay with elements of action, exploration, adventure, puzzle-solving, strategy, and role-playing into one experience.

Localization.Title: Jak 3
Localization.Description: After saving Haven City once again, Jak and Daxter find themselves poisoned forced into competition on the international car-racing circuit by the execution of Krew's will.

Localization.Title: Jak 3
Localization.Description: Jak 3 se présente comme un jeu d'action et de plates-formes sur PS2. Dans ce troisième volet, Jak et son fidèle compagnon Daxter sont exilés vers une impitoyable terre à l'abandon.

Localization.Title: Jak 3
Localization.Description: Jak 3 wird als Action- und Plattformspiel auf PS2 präsentiert. In diesem dritten Teil werden Jak und sein treuer Begleiter Daxter in ein gnadenloses, verlassenes Land verbannt.

Localization.Title: Jak 3
Localization.Description: Jak 3 es un videojuego de plataformas de acción-aventura que sigue con el planteamiento de la anterior entrega. Villa refugio se ha convertido en un campo de batalla en el que tres facciones enfrentadas se disputan el control de las calles.

Localization.Title: Jak 3
Localization.Description: After saving Haven City once again, Jak and Daxter find themselves poisoned forced into competition on the international car-racing circuit by the execution of Krew's will.

Localization.Title: Jak 3
Localization.Description: Depois de salvar Haven City mais uma vez, Jak e Daxter se encontram envenenados e forçados a competir no circuito internacional de corridas de carros pela execução do testamento de Krew.

Localization.Title: Sly 2: Band of Thieves
Localization.Description: Thief and raccoon Sly Cooper returns in a new cel-shaded platforming adventure wherein he forms a band of thieves with Bentley the turtle and Murray the purple, hippo-like creature, which each have their own role within the game.

Localization.Title: Sly 2: Band of Thieves
Localization.Description: Sly 2 : Association de Voleurs est un jeu de plates-formes 3D disponible sur Playstation 2. Sly est un cambrioleur d'exception, mais le clan Klaww récupère les pièces de Clockwerk pour les utiliser à des fins terribles.

Localization.Title: Sly 2: Band of Thieves
Localization.Description: Sly 2: Association of Thieves ist ein 3D-Plattformspiel für Playstation 2. Sly ist ein außergewöhnlicher Einbrecher, aber der Klaww-Clan holt die Teile von Clockwerk zurück, um sie für schreckliche Zwecke zu verwenden. Coopers Team will sie aufhalten.

Localization.Title: Sly 2: Band of Thieves
Localization.Description: Sly regresa en una nueva aventura de plataformas en la que forma una banda de ladrones con Bentley la tortuga y Murray, la criatura morada parecida a un hipopótamo, cada uno tiene su propio papel dentro del juego.

Localization.Title: Sly 2: Band of Thieves
Localization.Description: Sly 2: Association of Thieves è un gioco di piattaforma 3D disponibile su Playstation 2. Sly è un ladro eccezionale, ma il clan Klaww recupera i pezzi di Clockwerk per usarli per scopi terribili. La squadra di Cooper va a fermarli.

Localization.Title: Sly 2: Band of Thieves
Localization.Description: Sly 2: Association of Thieves é um jogo de plataformas 3D disponível na Playstation 2. Sly é um ladrão excepcional, mas o clã Klaww recupera os pedaços de Clockwerk para os utilizar para fins terríveis. A equipa de Cooper vai detê-los.

Localization.Title: Crisis Zone
Localization.Description: This third Time Crisis game designed for PlayStation 2 sets the light-gun shooter action in a busy commercial district in the suburbs of London.

Localization.Title: Crisis Zone
Localization.Description: Crisis Zone est un jeu de tir sur PS2 qui vous met dans la peau d'un agent de la Force Tactique Spéciale dont l'objectif principal est de sécuriser Londres des terroristes dans un environnement destructible.

Localization.Title: Crisis Zone
Localization.Description: Crisis Zone ist ein PS2-Shooter, der Sie in die Rolle eines Agenten der Special Tactical Force versetzt, dessen Hauptziel darin besteht, London in einer zerstörbaren Umgebung vor Terroristen zu schützen.

Localization.Title: Crisis Zone
Localization.Description: Crisis Zone es un 'Lightgun Shooter' de Namco al más puro estilo de la serie Time Crisis, que llega desde las salas Arcade en exclusiva para PlayStation 2.

Localization.Title: Crisis Zone
Localization.Description: This third Time Crisis game designed for PlayStation 2 sets the light-gun shooter action in a busy commercial district in the suburbs of London.

Localization.Title: Crisis Zone
Localization.Description: This third Time Crisis game designed for PlayStation 2 sets the light-gun shooter action in a busy commercial district in the suburbs of London.

Localization.Title: SingStar
Localization.Description: SingStar is a competitive music video game series for PlayStation consoles, developed by London Studio and published by Sony Computer Entertainment. Dozens of installments were released for the PlayStation 2, and several more for the PlayStation 3.

Localization.Title: SingStar
Localization.Description: Singstar est un vrai karaoke disponible sur Playstation 2. Pour jouer, c'est très simple. Que ce soit seul ou entre amis, il suffit de choisir son morceau, d'attraper le micro, et de chanter ! Plus de 30 titres et clips originaux sont présents.

Localization.Title: SingStar
Localization.Description: Singstar ist ein echtes Karaoke, das auf der Playstation 2 verfügbar ist. Es ist sehr einfach zu spielen. Ob alleine oder mit Freunden, einfach Lied auswählen, Mikrofon schnappen und singen! Es sind mehr als 30 Originaltitel und -clips vorhanden.

Localization.Title: Everybody's Golf
Localization.Description: Clap Hanz Limited invites PlayStation 2 gamers back for another round, in this fourth edition of the cartoonish golf sim with the serious gameplay.

Localization.Title: Everybody's Golf
Localization.Description: Everybody's Golf est un jeu de golf disponible sur PS2. Au design cartoonesque, le titre propose néanmoins une vraie simulation de golf, avec plus d'une vingtaine de personnages disponibles sur treize parcours différents.

Localization.Title: Everybody's Golf
Localization.Description: Everybody's Golf ist ein Golfspiel, das für PS2 verfügbar ist. Trotz seines Cartoon-Designs bietet der Titel dennoch eine echte Golfsimulation mit mehr als zwanzig Charakteren auf dreizehn verschiedenen Golfplätzen.

Localization.Title: Everybody's Golf
Localization.Description: Everybodys Golf regresa en PS2, ahora más grande y mejor que nunca.

Localization.Title: Everybody's Golf
Localization.Description: Clap Hanz Limited invites PlayStation 2 gamers back for another round, in this fourth edition of the cartoonish golf sim with the serious gameplay.

Localization.Title: Tekken's Nina Williams in: Death by Degrees
Localization.Description: Nina Williams, world-renowned assassin, has been hired by the CIA and MI6 to join a team which is attempting to infiltrate "Kometa," a notorious criminal organization.

Localization.Title: Tekken's Nina Williams in: Death by Degrees
Localization.Description: Death by Degrees sur PS2 est un jeu d'action dans lequel vous incarnez Nina Williams, une tueuse à gage échappée de la série Tekken. Infiltrée sur un bateau, vous allez devoir tuer du méchant à grands coups de talon aiguille.

Localization.Title: Tekken's Nina Williams in: Death by Degrees
Localization.Description: Death by Degrees für PS2 ist ein Actionspiel, in dem Sie als Nina Williams spielen, eine entkommene Auftragsmörderin aus der Tekken-Serie. Auf einem Boot eingedrungen, musst du den Bösewicht mit kräftigen Schlägen deines Stilettos töten.

Localization.Title: Tekken's Nina Williams in: Death by Degrees
Localization.Description: Nina Williams, asesina de renombre mundial, ha sido contratada por la CIA y el MI6 para unirse a un equipo que intenta infiltrarse en Kometa, una notoria organización criminal.

Localization.Description: EyeToy: Play 2 is the sequel to the first EyeToy: Play game and includes 12 new mini-games to play using the EyeToy USB camera.

Localization.Title: EyeToy: Play 2
Localization.Description: EyeToy : Play 2 sur PS2 vous propose plusieurs mini-jeux se jouant avec la caméra EyeToy de la console.

Localization.Title: EyeToy: Play 2
Localization.Description: EyeToy: Play 2 auf PS2 bietet mehrere Minispiele, die mit der EyeToy-Kamera der Konsole gespielt werden.

Localization.Description: Use your PlayStation 2 to mix House records. The game gives you two decks, mixer, sampler, effects unit and loops unit and lets you loose on 70 tunes from the likes of Masters at Work, Dimitri from Paris, Shapeshifters, DJ Gregory, Francios K.

Localization.Title: DJ: Decks & FX: Claudio Coccoluto Edition
Localization.Description: Si vous aimez la musique et fréquentez assidûment les boîtes de nuit, permettez-moi de vous présenter celui qui sera certainement le nouveau compagnon de vos nuits blanches.

Localization.Title: The Getaway: Black Monday
Localization.Description: It's going to be a day to remember for Sgt Mitchell. His first shift back on the MET's Organised Crime Squad begins with a dawn raid on a council estate that turns nasty.

Localization.Title: The Getaway: Black Monday
Localization.Description: The Getaway : Black Monday est un jeu d'action disponible sur Playstation 2. Le joueur incarne Mitch, un flic névrosé et Eddie, un boxeur entraîné, tous deux lancés dans une guerre des gangs.

Localization.Title: The Getaway: Black Monday
Localization.Description: The Getaway: Black Monday ist ein Actionspiel für Playstation 2. Der Spieler spielt Mitch, einen neurotischen Polizisten, und Eddie, einen ausgebildeten Boxer, die beide in einen Bandenkrieg verwickelt sind.

Localization.Title: The Getaway: Black Monday
Localization.Description: «En mi barrio, nos movemos por necesidad, no por deseo». «Que sepas que, sigues vivo porque te necesito». Las calles de Londres están dominadas por una panda de criminales. Y sus miembros no son precisamente amables cuando se les lleva la contraria.

Localization.Title: MotoGP 4
Localization.Description: MotoGP 4 is a motorcycle racing game based on the 2004 MotoGP season. It features all the riders and tracks from the season, not just from the main MotoGP class but from the development 125cc and 250cc series.

Localization.Title: MotoGP 4
Localization.Description: Avec MotoGP 4 sur PS2, incarnez un pilote professionnel et vivez l'intensité du championnat du monde de vitesse moto.

Localization.Title: MotoGP 4
Localization.Description: Moto GP 4 für PS2 ist ein Rennspiel, bei dem Sie leistungsstarke Motorräder auf Strecken steuern, die von den größten Wettbewerben der Welt stammen.

Localization.Title: MotoGP 4
Localization.Description: MotoGP 4 es el cuarto y último juego de MotoGP lanzado para PlayStation 2 publicado y desarrollado por Namco.
